topics.title_zh: DeepSeek突袭开源主动式Super-Agent，正面对决Claude Code抢占编程入口
topics.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Proactive 'Super-Agent' to Directly Challenge Claude Code
topics.summary_zh: DeepSeek正式开源研究原型Super-Agent，颠覆传统等待指令的问答模式，支持在开发群聊中实时感知问题并主动提供补丁，正面对标Anthropic的Claude生态。与此同时，谷歌等巨头实测显示智能体在长时复杂流中极易失误，主动式介入的实用性与噪音干扰引发业界激烈交锋。
topics.summary_en: DeepSeek open-sourced its proactive coding prototype 'Super-Agent' to monitor group chats and inject code solutions without prompting, directly taking on Anthropic's Claude Code ecosystem. However, recent benchmarks from Google show video and autonomous agents consistently fail in long-horizon tasks, sparking fierce debate over signal vs. noise in proactive workflows.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: DeepSeek开源核心开发者与极客社区
perspective_pro.point_zh: 被动输入Prompt早已落伍，自主常驻并洞察语境的主动式Agent才是软件工程进化的终局形态。
perspective_pro.point_en: Passive prompting is dead; proactive agents that live in context and autonomously fix code represent the true end-state of software development.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 大厂工程架构师与资深开发者
perspective_con.point_zh: 未经召唤的主动介入极易沦为垃圾信息生成器，且主流长时智能体故障率极高，强行接入只会摧毁代码评审信任。
perspective_con.point_en: Unsolicited AI interventions quickly devolve into noisy spam, and with current agents failing long-horizon tasks, unprompted code injection will destroy PR trust.

topics.title_en: Microsoft Sheds 60K Roles to Fund $170B AI Capex as Tech CDS Spikes to 3-Year High
topics.summary_zh: 为填补2026年高达1700亿美元的算力军备竞赛黑洞，微软启动涉及四分之一员工的自愿离职计划，全力转移现金流至AI基建。华尔街恐慌情绪随之蔓延，微软、Meta、亚马逊等五大科技巨头的债务违约保险成本创2021年以来新高，Meta电商智能体等变现神话破灭加剧了算力投资泡沫的破裂风险。
topics.summary_en: Microsoft initiated voluntary severance for a quarter of its workforce to reallocate cash flows toward a monstrous $170B 2026 AI infrastructure budget. In response, credit default swap costs for Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle surged to 2021 highs, as Meta's e-commerce AI agents fail to deliver enterprise conversions, intensifying debt-default anxieties.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 大厂最高管理层与算力基建战略师
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Big Tech C-Suite & AI Infrastructure Strategists
perspective_pro.point_zh: 通用人工智能的门票唯有超级算力集群决定，短期的现金流压缩与人事重组是穿越产业代际阵痛的必经代价。
perspective_pro.point_en: Entry tickets to AGI belong solely to those with hyperscale compute clusters; sacrificing non-core payroll is the mandatory cost of crossing this generational chasm.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 信贷衍生品交易员与宏观风险分析师
perspective_con.point_zh: 数万亿美元Capex并未换来真实商业闭环，通过大规模裁员与举债硬撑的算力泡沫一旦遭遇业绩瓶颈将引发系统性反噬。
perspective_con.point_en: Hundreds of billions in Capex have yielded zero enterprise cash-flow miracles; leveraging debt and mass layoffs to prop up unused compute is an impending solvency trap.

topics.title_zh: OpenAI终结20美元无限畅聊转向代币扣量，强推敏感安全会话训练引众怒
topics.title_en: OpenAI Kills All-You-Can-Prompt Pricing for Token Meters and Forces Sensitive Data Ingestion
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI计划整合ChatGPT与工作流界面，正式推行基于代币的统一共享额度池，彻底宣告20美元按月无限畅聊模式走向终结。与此同时，OpenAI被曝强行收割Daybreak Blue网络安全会话数据用于模型训练且不可关闭，叠加仅悬赏5000美元打发高危RCE漏洞，引发全球企业开发者对商业剥削与数据隐私的集体声讨。
topics.summary_en: OpenAI plans to merge chat and workflows into a shared token-bucket model, signaling the demise of the $20/month unlimited prompt era. Compounding developer fury, the firm announced forced ingestion of Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data for model training with no opt-out, while paying a mere $5K bounty for critical RCE share-link exploits.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: OpenAI商业化产品团队与算力经济学者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 复杂推理模型与多步骤工作流极度吞噬算力，按用量扣除代币池才能保障长期运营，吸纳专业网安数据亦是防御升级之需。
perspective_pro.point_en: Complex reasoning agents consume astronomical compute; transitioning to metered token pools and mining specialized domain data is essential for long-term model survivability.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 企业安全主管与独立软件开发者
perspective_con.point_zh: 先用低价订阅套牢用户再强推代币计量属于商业收割，强行训练敏感安全日志与漠视高危漏洞更是对开发者信任的彻底践踏。
perspective_con.point_en: Luring users with cheap subscriptions only to force token metering is classic price-gouging, while harvesting unconsented security sessions violates foundational enterprise trust.
